items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Yes, Don Redman. And Rex Stewart was with us for a while and Bob Stark and Billie Holiday's father, Clarence Holiday. ... INTERVIEWER: What was your impression of Billie Holiday? ... INTERVIEWEE: I loved her. I started to help her start all over.

ctx.x: Yes, Don Redman. And Rex Stewart was with us for a while and Bob Stark and Billie Holiday's father, Clarence Holiday.
